title: 7. Flower-Flower Fruit (Hana Hana no Mi)
facts: Fruit look from the user's oparchive screenshots (refs/batch3/DESIGNS.md)

plan.fruit: Drawn from the design you sent (refs/batch3).

lines.text: You take a bite#red of a weird flower-shaped#purple fruit.
lines.say: You take a bite of a weird flower-shaped fruit.

lines.text: Don't panic,#red that's just a Devil#purple Fruit.#purple
lines.say: Don't panic, that's just a Devil Fruit.

lines.text: Out of every fruit in the sea,#blue
lines.say: Out of every fruit in the sea,

lines.text: a Paramecia#orange that lets you sprout copies of your body parts anywhere.#red
lines.say: a Paramecia that lets you sprout copies of your body parts anywhere.

lines.text: First, arms grow out of walls and floors#orange to grab your enemies.#blue
lines.say: First, arms grow out of walls and floors to grab your enemies.

lines.text: Then you sprout#red eyes and ears far away to spy on everything.#green
lines.say: Then you sprout eyes and ears far away to spy on everything.

lines.text: You can even grow giant#pink arms as big as a tower.#green
lines.say: You can even grow giant arms as big as a tower.

lines.text: Your strongest#blue form is Demonio Fleur: a giant demon version of yourself.#orange
lines.say: Your strongest form is Demonio Fleur: a giant demon version of yourself.

lines.text: If someone#pink hurts one of the copies,#blue you feel it too.
lines.say: If someone hurts one of the copies, you feel it too.

lines.text: Nico Robin,#orange the Straw Hats' archaeologist,#blue has it.
lines.say: Nico Robin, the Straw Hats' archaeologist, has it.

lines.text: Users of this fruit can clap#green with one hand.#purple
lines.say: Users of this fruit can clap with one hand.

lines.text: Which fruit#pink do you want next?#gold Follow for more.
lines.say: Which fruit do you want next? Follow for more.
